name: addCategoryToParticipant
shortDescription: Links a category to a Stump participant, defining their areas of focus or expertise for task assignment.
description:
Overview

Creates a ParticipantCategory record to link a Category to a User (Stump), defining the participant's contextual responsibilities.

Intended use

Called by Lead Points or Stumps from the Quadrant and Participant Detail View UI to define a Stump's areas of focus. Parameters include stumpId (or ctx.user_id if Stump is calling) and categoryId.

Logic

  1. Determine targetStumpId: if ctx.role is 'stump', use ctx.user_id; otherwise, use params.stumpId and validate that params.stumpId corresponds to an existing User with the stump app role. If not found or not a Stump, return an error.
  2. Validate that params.categoryId exists by querying the Category entity using ctx.data.get. If not found, return an error.
  3. Check if a ParticipantCategory record already exists for the given targetStumpId and categoryId using ctx.data.query. If it does, return a conflict error or the existing record.
  4. Create a new ParticipantCategory record using ctx.data.create with idOfUser (the targetStumpId), categoryId, and assignedByUserId (from ctx.user_id).
  5. Audit-log the association using ctx.audit.log, including the stump and category IDs.
  6. Return the created ParticipantCategory record.

Entities

  • ParticipantCategory
  • User
  • Category
